svg.title: Codex subagents for Claude Code architecture
svg.desc: Claude Code forwarders or a terminal pass a task file to the waiter. Each turn has one detached driver and one dedicated Codex CLI app-server. Authenticated IPC carries control, while private files hold prompts, bounded progress and immutable results. The CLI uses native login to reach the remote model service. Separate verification compares actual checkout bytes against an in-memory baseline of a complete sealed-commit checkout, removes settled snapshots when identity is proven, and retains logs.
svg.text: One owned driver and app-server per turn
